content: Kadiloka ya̱kids bitatams tasiyas gabman sikaleiwag waseg. Asibabaw-wan Yowbad bo isekes sikaleiwag. Anmwa̱net Yowbad kaleiwag isekes gamag.
Kukin bitapiyev sikaleiwag, mamagina bitapiyev Yowbad nawotet; igaw mo bikatimop adsinap kalbaleb.
Tasiyas asisinap bwein nag biwenes tasiyas takaleiwags; nag. Tage takalbalebs biwenes. Kadiloka beibwein amisinap, mo takaleiwag bikalin nuwan yakamiy, va̱gan bikavasimiy. Nag bukuwenes, nag.
Yowbad bo isek inakaleiwag towen va̱gan bilabeim. Tage kukin beivag amsinap kalbaleb mo bukuwen. Nakaleiwag nises va̱gan beiweiy gamag. Mtowen Yowbad natouwat va̱gan beiweiys tasiyas takalbalebs.
Kadiloka bitakanaway gabman sikaleiwag. Kukin gog nag, Yowbad mo bikawkuneid. E, kadiloka bitakanawes.
Kadiloka-vak bukupa̱yins gabman waseg. Takaleiwags tasiyas itoukums Yowbad nawotet pinamiy yakamiy.
Kutams asibabaw wasigeis. Kupa̱yins wasigeis tasiyas takaweins pa̱yin. Sita̱kis kusekes tasiyas takaweins ta̱kis. Kugoulus tasiyas guyawaw, o kuvna̱ses tammwayas.
Awoum kukwawlavags wasigeis gamag mwasanin. Misinaka bukusiwa̱youbs simiyas wasigeis. Bitasiwa̱youb mo bitakanow Moses nakaleiwag bitayakous.
E, wanuwan livan towen kaleiwag babaw nisesus, mamagina:

content.text: “Awoum kusubwan, awoum kuweiy gamag, awoum kuveinaw, awoum matam bimwamon soum navavag.”

content: Towen tasiwa̱youb bivna̱ses siney, nag biyagages, nag. Kukin bitasiwa̱youbs mo bitakanawes Moses nakaleiwag bitayakous.
E, kuva̱ges ma̱wan, peinan kukwakins datuts bo talivatus. Kadiloka kwannakons tut towen. Kweiboug nitasimounids, tage datuts bo ikous. Yowbad kakita bikatinabweids.
Boug bo ikous. Kakita beiyam. Kadiloka bitapiyaves dadub sinapun, bitakawes kamnat youdanen va̱gan bitakanaviys waseg sinap kalbaleb.

Kadiloka bitavna̱ses adsinaps beibwein, mamagina kamnat gimgeilin ya̱kids. Awoum bitamwamoums wiskiy o aveiyag mo bitakabala̱weins. Awoum bitakaninavays mav. Awoum bitakavikuns o bitakamnimans, awoum.
Kadiloka kukwawes daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis ansinap. Tage awoum kutams waseg woumiy nakaleiwag, aveiyag sivinan, awoum.
